prevention.title: Extinction limits at sub-lunar oxygen

findings.text: FLEX observed 58 liquid-fuel rows ending in extinction, the lowest at 12.0% oxygen measured with N2 diluent.
FLEX observed 40 liquid-fuel rows ending in extinction, the lowest at 13.0% oxygen measured with N2+He diluent.
ACME CFI-G recorded 183 self-extinguished gas-fuel rows, the lowest at 13.5% oxygen measured with N2.

prevention.implication: Designers must test fire-suppression and extinguishment strategies at 30% or higher oxygen and ≤70.3 kPa because extinction was only seen below about 25% oxygen in the data.
prevention.gap: The dataset lacks extinction or self-extinction results for any fuel at lunar-base oxygen levels (30%+).

detection.title: What NASA PSI records show on detection

findings.text: SAME-R recorded 109 tests with solid fuels at 21% oxygen (assumed cabin air).
SAME recorded 20 tests with solid fuels at 21% oxygen (assumed cabin air).
DAFT / DAFT-2 recorded no individual tests with dust fuels.

detection.implication: Solid-material tests in PSI stop below the 30% oxygen expected in a lunar base, so detection findings need checking at lunar conditions.
detection.gap: No partial-gravity combustion data is in PSI yet.

suppression.title: Lunar Habitat Fire Suppression Insights

findings.text: FLEX observed 123 liquid-fuel rows with N2+CO2 at measured oxygen 14.0%-25.0% and 88 extinguishments, the lowest at 14.0% oxygen.
BASS-II tested solid fuels with measured oxygen 13.6%-22.2% at 101 kPa, covering the highest solid-material oxygen measured in the dataset.
BASS examined solid fabrics at nominal cabin air 21.0% oxygen and 101 kPa, providing data at the typical spacecraft atmosphere.

suppression.implication: Designers must test suppression agents and extinguishment strategies at 30% oxygen or higher because existing microgravity data only cover up to 25% oxygen for liquids and 22.2% for solids.
suppression.gap: The dataset lacks partial-gravity combustion results and extinction outcomes for gas-fuel or liquid-fuel tests at lunar-base oxygen levels.
